inputs.resume_text:
Aditi Mehta
PGP 2026-28 | Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad
Chartered Accountant (ICAI, AIR 34, Nov 2021)

ACADEMICS
PGP, IIM Ahmedabad, 2026-28 (ongoing), Term 1 GPA 3.1/4.33
B.Com (Hons), Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University, 2020, 82.4%
Class XII, Jamnabai Narsee School, Mumbai, 2017, 95.6%

WORK EXPERIENCE (30 months)
Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP, Mumbai | Assistant Manager, Audit & Assurance | Jan 2022 - Jun 2024
- Led statutory audit fieldwork for 4 listed FMCG and consumer durable clients with combined revenue of INR 18,000 crore
- Identified INR 46 crore of trade-promotion accrual errors at a personal care client by reconciling scheme payouts with distributor claims
- Built a sales-return analytics template in Excel that cut testing time by 30% and was adopted across 3 audit teams
- Supervised a team of 5 article assistants
Deloitte, Article Assistant | 2018 - 2021

ACTIVITIES
- Member, Marketing Club (Mark-It), IIM Ahmedabad: running a D2C brand teardown series
- Semi-finalist, Asian Paints CANVAS 2026 marketing case competition
- Co-founded "Chai with CAs", an Instagram page explaining tax for salaried people; 14,000 followers
- Trained Bharatanatyam dancer; performed at 12 cultural festivals

concerns.detail: The candidate is moving from audit and assurance into marketing.

plan.warmup_question: What is one idea from your first term at IIMA that has already been useful?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your background, up to how your first term at the MBA has gone.

slots.core_question: You've built your experience in audit and are now pursuing marketing. What's pulling you toward marketing roles?
slots.intent_private: Needs a reason grounded in Aditi's audit or consumer-facing experiences, evidence of steps taken in the MBA toward marketing, and a specific aspect of the role that fits her path.
likely_probes: Which part of your audit work first made marketing interesting to you?
What have you done in the MBA so far to test that interest?
What other roles or companies are you considering?

slots.core_question: What were you trying to solve when you co-founded Chai with CAs?
slots.intent_private: Needs the audience problem, Aditi's personal decisions and actions, and how she assessed whether the page was reaching and helping salaried people.
likely_probes: What part of building the page did you personally own?
Which content decision had the biggest effect on the page?
What was the 14,000-follower figure compared with when you started?

slots.core_question: Tell me about a time you disagreed with your team or took a stance.
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific disagreement or independent position, Aditi's reasoning and actions, and the outcome of how the team handled it.
likely_probes: What was your own position in that situation?
What did you do first to make your view clear?
What changed after the team made its decision?

slots.core_question: How did your team approach the Asian Paints CANVAS case competition?
slots.intent_private: Needs Aditi's specific contribution, the marketing judgment or analysis behind the recommendation, and the evidence supporting the team's semi-finalist result.
likely_probes: What part of the case did you personally own?
Which marketing choice did your team debate most?
How did you judge whether your recommendation was working?

plan.plan_notes: The plan prioritizes the candidate's distinctive marketing-relevant initiative, case competition, and quantified consumer-business analysis while explicitly testing the audit-to-marketing switch through motivation. The resume is strong and quantified, but direct marketing experience is limited, so the fit slot checks conviction and teamwork without adding a separate concern question.
